steps.name: PIM navigation item should be visible in the left sidebar locator('a:has-text("PIM")').or(locator('a[href*="viewpim" i]'))
Employee List button should be visible in the top navigation locator('text=Employee List')
Add Employee button should be visible in the top navigation locator('.orangehrm-paper-container .oxd-button').filter({ hasText: /Add/i })
Save button should be visible confirming the Add Employee form is loaded locator('.oxd-form-actions button').filter({ hasText: 'Save' })

Login Status should default to Enabled before form submission locator('.oxd-form > .orangehrm-employee-container').locator('.oxd-input-group').filter({ hasText: /Status/i }).locator('.oxd-radio-wrapper').filter({ hasText: /Enabled/i }).locator('input[type="radio"]')

First Name field should NOT display a validation error after successful save locator('.oxd-form .oxd-input-group').filter({ has: locator('input[name="firstName"]') }).first().locator('span.oxd-input-field-error-message').first()

Last Name field should NOT display a validation error after successful save locator('.oxd-form .oxd-input-group').filter({ has: locator('input[name="lastName"]') }).locator('span.oxd-input-field-error-message').first()

Username field should NOT display a validation error after successful save locator('.oxd-form > .orangehrm-employee-container').locator('.oxd-input-group').filter({ hasText: /Username/i }).locator('span.oxd-input-field-error-message')

Password field should NOT display a validation error after successful save locator('.oxd-form > .orangehrm-employee-container').locator('.oxd-input-group').filter({ hasText: /Password/i }).first().locator('span.oxd-input-field-error-message')

Confirm Password field should NOT display a validation error after successful save locator('.oxd-form > .orangehrm-employee-container').locator('.oxd-input-group').filter({ hasText: /Password/i }).last().locator('span.oxd-input-field-error-message')
